headline: Maui Planning Commission

meeting.summary: The Maui Planning Commission met to keep working on the South Maui Community Plan.
meeting.recap: The Maui Planning Commission met to keep working on the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:00:42]] The planning director said the department does not recommend adding land outside the urban growth boundary, the line that marks where growth may happen.[[0:03:43]] The director said such a change would also need a recommendation to amend the Maui Island Plan.[[0:04:00]] A resident asked the commission for a public hearing.[[0:10:14]] A resident said there are only two roads out of her area during emergencies.[[0:11:37]] A company representative asked the commission to change one parcel from agriculture to industrial.[[0:43:57]] Six commissioners voted for other policy changes for that area, with parks added.[[3:04:19]] A motion to change the requested parcel to industrial was withdrawn.[[3:27:59]] The next meeting is December 10.[[3:31:11]]
decided: Commissioners agreed to list lineal descendants first and remove the numbers from the stakeholder list.
meeting.next: The next agenda is planned to cover sub-area 3 and its connected areas of change. The director said staff will work with the commission's legal adviser on a clearer process for growth boundary change requests. People can email written testimony to the planning department.

moments.q: "that's five votes in favor okay motion carries"
